title: Spicy Korean Jjigae
description: A hearty, spicy Korean stew made with sujjuk and mushrooms. Serve with a side of rice.
instructions: Heat a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sujjuk and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the blanch and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions if desired.
